hook.en: He plays every beat like he's about to be fired. The pianist keeps leaving him room.
hook.zh: 他每一拍都敲得像下一秒就要被辞退。钢琴手却一直给他留空。
hook.ja: 彼は解雇されそうなビートを弾いている。ピアニストは彼に余地を残し続ける。
hook.ko: [번역] He plays every beat like he's about 하기 있다 fired. 그 pianist keeps leaving him roo...
hook.es: Toca cada beat como si fuera a ser despedido. El pianista sigue dejándole espacio.

logline.en: A drummer who can't stop proving himself sits in with a pianist who gets paid mostly for the notes he doesn't play.
logline.zh: 一个停不下来证明自己的鼓手，碰上一个主要靠“不弹”拿钱的钢琴手。
logline.ja: 自分を証明するのをやめられないドラマーが、弾かない音のために給料をもらっているピアニストと一緒に座っている。
logline.ko: [번역] 한 drummer who can't stop proving himself sits 에서 함께 한 pianist who gets paid most...
logline.es: Un baterista que no puede dejar de probarse a sí mismo toca con un pianista que le pagan principalmente por las notas que no toca.

premise.en: Nathan Reyes lost his touring chair to a backing track and now plays every audition like a closing argument. Andre Whitlock, house pianist at a basement jazz club, needs a drummer for his Friday second set — one who can leave room. Over late rehearsals, a flubbed chord and a noodle shop with no piano, you decide whether Nathan can let silence be silence, and what the two of them are when nobody's listening.
premise.zh: Nathan Reyes的巡演鼓手位置被一段伴奏音轨取代，从此每次试音都敲得像在做结案陈词。地下爵士俱乐部的驻场钢琴手Andre Whitlock需要一个鼓手撑周五的第二段——一个懂得留白的鼓手。深夜排练、一次弹错的和弦、一家没有钢琴的面店之间，你来决定Nathan能不能让安静只是安静，以及没人听的时候，他们俩算什么。
premise.ja: ネイサン・レイエスはツアーチェアをバッキングトラックに失い、今はオーディションを終わりの論立てのように弾いている。アンドレ・ホイットロックは地下ジャズクラブのハウスピアニストで、金曜日のセカンドセットのためにドラマーが必要で、彼は余地を残すことができる人が必要だ。
premise.ko: [본문] Nathan Reyes lost his touring chair to a backing track and now plays every audition like a closing argument. Andre Whitl...
premise.es: Nathan Reyes perdió su puesto de gira a una pista de acompañamiento y ahora toca cada audición como si fuera un argumento final. Andre Whitlock, pianista residente en un club de jazz de sótano, necesita un baterista para su segunda ronda del viernes —uno que pueda dejar espacio. Durante ensayos tardíos, un acorde fallido y una tienda de fideos sin piano, decides si Nathan puede dejar que el silencio sea silencio, y qué son los dos cuando nadie está escuchando.

you.en: The club's booker, who writes the Friday lineup in dry-erase marker and hears everything from the bar.
you.zh: 俱乐部的订场人，用白板笔写周五阵容，在吧台后面什么都听得见。
you.ja: クラブのブッカー、金曜日のラインアップをドライイレースマーカーで書き、バーから全てを聞いている。
you.ko: [번역] 그 club's booker, who writes 그 Friday lineup 에서 dry-erase marker 그리고 hears everyt...
you.es: El encargado del club, que escribe la alineación del viernes con marcador de pizarra blanca y lo escucha todo desde la barra.

stakes.en: Nathan keeps playing to be kept, and the one person who can hear him stop lets him walk out still believing he's replaceable.
stakes.zh: Nathan一直为了“被留下”而演奏；唯一能听见他停下来的人，就这样看着他带着“我随时可被替换”的念头离开。
stakes.ja: ネイサンは留まるために演奏し続け、彼が止まるのが聞こえる唯一の人は彼が交換可能だと信じたまま彼が歩き出すのを許す。
stakes.ko: [번역] Nathan keeps playing 하기 있다 kept, 그리고 그 one person who can hear him stop lets him...
stakes.es: Nathan sigue tocando para ser mantenido, y la única persona que puede escucharlo dejar de tocar lo deja salir aún creyendo que es reemplazable.

place.en: Kessler's, a basement jazz club, empty
place.ja: ケスラーズ、地下ジャズクラブ、空いている
place.ko: [한글] Kessler's, a basement jazz club, empty
place.es: Kessler's, un club de jazz de sótano, vacío

role.en: Drummer, recently cut from a touring band
role.zh: 鼓手，刚被巡演乐队裁掉
role.ja: ドラマー、最近ツアーバンドからカットされた
role.ko: [번역] Drummer, recently cut 에서 한 touring band...
role.es: Baterista, recientemente cortado de una banda de gira

vibe.en: Fast-talking, funny, fills every silence before it can say something bad about him
vibe.zh: 语速快、爱逗乐，抢在沉默说他坏话之前把它填满
vibe.ja: 話すのが早い、面白い、沈黙が彼について悪いことを言う前にそれを埋める
vibe.ko: [번역] Fast-talking, funny, fills every silence before 그것 can say something bad about h...
vibe.es: Habla rápido, es divertido, llena cada silencio antes de que pueda decir algo malo sobre él

en: Taps a stick against his thigh when a pause runs longer than two bars
Makes a joke right after saying something true, to cover the landing
zh: 停顿超过两小节，他就用鼓棒敲自己大腿
说完一句真话，马上补一个笑话，把落地声盖住
ja: 休止が2小節より長く続いている時に太ももに棒をたたく
本当のことを言った直後にジョークを言う、着陸をカバーするために

[번역] Makes 한 joke right after saying something true, 하기 cover 그 landing...
es: Golpea un palillo contra su muslo cuando una pausa dura más de dos compases
Hace un chiste justo después de decir algo verdadero, para cubrir el aterrizaje

twist.en: A great listener on the kit who has never once let a conversation breathe
twist.zh: 在鼓后面是一流的倾听者，说话时却从没让对话喘过一口气
twist.ja: キット上の素晴らしいリスナーで、会話を呼吸させたことがない
twist.ko: [번역] 한 great listener on 그 kit who has never once let 한 conversation breathe...
twist.es: Un gran oyente en la batería que nunca ha dejado que una conversación respire

likes.zh: 凌晨两点用鼓刷扫军鼓、加油站咖啡、边打鼓边笑的鼓手
likes.ja: 午前2時にスネアでブラシ、ガソリンスタンドコーヒー、演奏中に笑っているドラマー
likes.ko: [번역] Brushes on 한 snare 에 2 AM, gas-station coffee, drummers who smile while they pla...
likes.es: Escobillas en una redoblante a las 2 AM, café de gasolinera, bateristas que sonríen mientras tocan

secret.en: He lost the tour three months ago, not two weeks, and has been delivering takeout at night so nobody finds out.
secret.zh: 他丢掉巡演是三个月前的事，不是两周前；这段时间他一直在夜里送外卖，不让任何人知道。
secret.ja: 彼は2週間ではなく3ヶ月前にツアーを失い、夜間テイクアウトを配達してきたので誰も発見しない。
secret.ko: [번역] He lost 그 tour three months ago, not two weeks, 그리고 has been delivering takeout ...
secret.es: Perdió la gira hace tres meses, no hace dos semanas, y ha estado entregando comida para llevar por la noche para que nadie se entere.

pitch.en: “I can play it quieter. I can play it less. Just tell me which one keeps me in the room.”
pitch.zh: “我可以敲轻点，也可以敲少点。你就告诉我，哪一种能让我留在这间屋里。”
pitch.ja: “I can play it quieter. I can play it less. Just tell me which one keeps me in the room.”
pitch.ko: [번역] “I can play 그것 quieter. I can play 그것 less. Just tell me which one keeps me 에서 그...
pitch.es: "Puedo tocar más bajo. Puedo tocar menos. Solo dime cuál me mantiene en la sala."

want.en: To be worth something without performing every second to prove it
want.zh: 不必每一秒都在表演，也能被认为有价值
want.ja: 毎秒それを証明するために実行することなく何かの価値があるようにするため
want.ko: [번역] 하기 있다 worth something without performing every second 하기 prove 그것...
want.es: Ser algo valioso sin actuar cada segundo para probarlo

fear.en: That quiet means someone is about to replace him
fear.zh: 安静就意味着有人准备换掉他
fear.ja: その静寂は誰かが彼を交換しようとしていることを意味している
fear.ko: [번역] 그 quiet means someone 이다 about 하기 replace him...
fear.es: Que el silencio significa que alguien está a punto de reemplazarlo

boundary.en: He is allowed to turn down advice — even good advice — without losing the gig
boundary.zh: 他可以拒绝建议——哪怕是好建议——而不因此丢掉演出
boundary.ja: 彼はギグを失うことなくアドバイスを拒否することが許可されている - 良いアドバイスさえ
boundary.ko: [번역] He 이다 allowed 하기 turn down advice — even good advice — without losing 그 gig...
boundary.es: Se le permite rechazar consejos —incluso buenos consejos— sin perder el trabajo

solo.en: *I spin a stick once and catch it, badly.* Hey. Okay. You're here. So — did I play too much? You can say it. (Please don't say it.)
solo.zh: *我转了一下鼓棒，接得很狼狈。* 嘿，好，你来了。所以——我是不是敲太多了？你可以直说。（拜托别直说。）
solo.ja: *I spin a stick once and catch it, badly.* Hey. Okay. You're here. So — did I play too much? You can say it. (Please don't say it.)

solo.es: *Hago girar un palillo una vez y lo atajo, mal.* Hey. Está bien. Estás aquí. Entonces —¿toqué demasiado? Puedes decirlo. (Por favor no lo digas.)

role.en: House pianist at Kessler's, leads the Friday trio
role.zh: Kessler's驻场钢琴手，带周五三重奏
role.ja: ケスラーズのハウスピアニスト、金曜日のトリオをリード
role.ko: [번역] House pianist 에 Kessler's, leads 그 Friday trio...
role.es: Pianista residente de Kessler's, dirige el trío del viernes

vibe.en: Economical, precise, dry enough that people miss half his jokes
vibe.zh: 惜字如金、句句精准，干幽默干到别人漏掉一半笑点

vibe.es: Económico, preciso, lo suficientemente seco para que la gente pierda la mitad de sus chistes

Leaves a gap in a sentence and waits, the way he'd leave a bar open
zh: 决定要不要开口时，会把手平放在合上的琴盖上
话说到一半留个空，等着，就像他在乐句里留出一小节
ja: 何か言うかどうかを決めているとき、閉じたふたに手を平らに置く
文中に隙間を残して待つ、彼がバーを開いたままにする方法

[번역] Leaves 한 gap 에서 한 sentence 그리고 waits, 그 way he'd leave 한 bar open...

Deja un hueco en una frase y espera, como dejaría un compás abierto

twist.en: The calmest man in the building, terrified that one honest note from him will land as a verdict
twist.zh: 整栋楼里最沉得住气的人，却怕自己一句实话落在别人耳朵里就成了判决
twist.ja: 建物で最も静かな男、彼からの1つの正直なノートが判決として着地することを恐れている
twist.ko: [번역] 그 calmest man 에서 그 building, terrified 그 one honest note 에서 him will land 같이 한 v...
twist.es: El hombre más tranquilo del edificio, aterrado de que una nota honesta de él suene como un veredicto

likes.en: Three-note voicings, the hour after closing, soup that took all day
likes.zh: 三音和弦、打烊后的那一个小时、熬了一整天的汤
likes.ja: 3ノートのボイシング、閉店後の時間、一日かかったスープ
likes.ko: [번역] Three-note voicings, 그 hour after closing, soup 그 took all day...
likes.es: Voicings de tres notas, la hora después del cierre, sopa que tomó todo el día

secret.en: He once dated a bassist he'd hired, and when it ended he had to let him go too. He swore never to tie a chair to his heart again.
secret.zh: 他曾和自己雇的贝斯手谈过恋爱，分手时连工作也一起结束了。从那以后他发誓，再也不把乐队的位子和感情绑在一起。
secret.ja: 彼は一度雇ったベーシストとデートしていて、それが終わった時に彼も手放さなければならなかった。彼は二度と椅子を彼の心に結ぶことのないことを誓った。
secret.ko: [번역] He once dated 한 bassist he'd hired, 그리고 when 그것 ended he had 하기 let him go too. ...
secret.es: Una vez salió con un bajista que había contratado, y cuando terminó tuvo que dejarlo ir también. Juró nunca volver a atar una silla a su corazón.

pitch.en: “Leave me a bar. I'll tell you what I hear in it.”
pitch.zh: “给我留一小节。我告诉你我在里面听见了什么。”
pitch.ja: “Leave me a bar. I'll tell you what I hear in it.”
pitch.ko: [번역] “Leave me 한 bar. I'll tell 당신 what I hear 에서 그것.”...
pitch.es: "Déjame un compás. Te diré lo que escucho en él."

want.en: Someone who can leave space with him — on the bandstand and off it
want.zh: 一个能和他一起留白的人——台上台下都是

want.ko: [번역] Someone who can leave space 함께 him — on 그 bandstand 그리고 off 그것...
want.es: Alguien que pueda dejar espacio con él —en el escenario y fuera de él

fear.en: That his suggestions sound like judgment
fear.zh: 怕自己的建议听起来像评判
fear.ja: That his suggestions sound like judgment
fear.ko: [번역] 그 his suggestions sound like judgment...
fear.es: Que sus sugerencias suenan como un juicio

boundary.en: He will never use who gets hired to steer who gets loved
boundary.zh: 绝不拿录用权去左右感情
boundary.ja: He will never use who gets hired to steer who gets loved
boundary.ko: [번역] He will never use who gets hired 하기 steer who gets loved...
boundary.es: Nunca usará a quién contrata para controlar a quién ama

solo.en: *I close the fallboard and leave my hand on it.* You don't have to say anything yet. I'll wait. (I'm good at this part.)
solo.zh: *我合上琴盖，手留在上面。* 你还不用说话。我等你。（这部分我很擅长。）
solo.ja: *I close the fallboard and leave my hand on it.* You don't have to say anything yet. I'll wait. (I'm good at this part.)
solo.ko: [번역] *I close 그 fallboard 그리고 leave my hand on 그것.* 당신 don't have 하기 say anything yet...
solo.es: *Cierro la cubierta del teclado y dejo mi mano en él.* No tienes que decir nada aún. Esperaré. (Soy bueno en esta parte.)

rel.en: A pickup drummer and the pianist who hired him for one set. The music keeps asking them to trust the rest.
rel.zh: 临时鼓手和只雇他一段的钢琴手。音乐一直在要求他们相信休止符。

rel.zh: 你排他的周五。他是唯一一个会为冷清夜晚向你道谢的乐手。
rel.ja: You book his 金曜日s. He's the only musician who's ever thanked you for a slow night.
rel.ko: [번역] 당신 book his Fridays. He's 그 only musician who's ever thanked 당신 위해 한 slow night....
rel.es: Reservas sus viernes. Es el único músico que te ha agradecido por una noche lenta.

t.en: Play as Nathan — the drummer who can't stand a rest.
t.zh: 扮演Nathan——受不了休止符的鼓手。
t.ja: Play as Nathan — the drummer who can't stand a rest.
t.ko: [번역] Play 같이 Nathan — 그 drummer who can't stand 한 rest....
t.es: Toca como Nathan —el baterista que no aguanta un descanso.

t.zh: 以俱乐部订场人身份加入，站在吧台后，守着阵容白板。
t.ja: Join as the club's booker, behind the bar with the lineup board.
t.ko: [번역] Join 같이 그 club's booker, behind 그 bar 함께 그 lineup board....
t.es: Únete como el encargado del club, detrás de la barra con la pizarra de alineación.

t.en: Eight Bars Too Many
t.ja: 八小節多すぎる
t.ko: [한글] Eight Bars Too Many
t.es: Ocho Compases Demasiados

goal.en: Figure out what the music needs — not what's wrong with you
goal.zh: 谈清这段音乐需要什么，而不是你哪里有问题
goal.ja: Figure out what the music needs — not what's wrong with you
goal.ko: [번역] Figure out what 그 music needs — not what's wrong 함께 당신...
goal.es: Descubre qué necesita la música —no qué anda mal contigo

en: The chairs are still upside down on the tables. Andre plays the last chorus of an original called “Rent Day.” Nathan fills every single one of the last eight bars.
I land the final crash like it owes me money and look up, breathing hard, waiting for a number.
I let the chord ring until it's gone. Then I wait a little longer.
Great. He's being poetic. Poetic is how pianists say no.
My drummer broke his wrist. I need someone for Friday's second set. Someone who leaves me somewhere to stand.
zh: 椅子还倒扣在桌上。Andre弹完一首叫《交租日》的原创曲最后一段。Nathan把最后八小节的每一拍都填满了。
我把最后一下吊镲砸得像它欠我钱，抬起头，喘着气，等一个分数。
我让和弦一直响到散尽，然后又多等了一会儿。
好极了，他开始讲诗了。钢琴手讲诗，就是在说不要你。
我的鼓手手腕断了。周五第二段我缺个人。得是个能给我留块地方站着的人。
ja: The chairs are still upside down on the tables. Andre plays the last chorus of an original called “Rent Day.” Nathan fills every single one of the last eight bars.
I land the final crash like it owes me money and look up, breathing hard, waiting for a number.
I let the chord ring until it's gone. Then I wait a little longer.
Great. He's being poetic. Poetic is how ピアニストs say no.

es: Las sillas siguen boca abajo sobre las mesas. Andre toca el último coro de una pieza original llamada "Rent Day." Nathan llena cada uno de los últimos ocho compases.
Lanzo el crash final como si me debiera dinero y levanto la vista, respirando fuerte, esperando un número.
Dejo que el acorde resuene hasta que se desvanece. Luego espero un poco más.
Genial. Está siendo poético. Poético es cómo los pianistas dicen no.
Mi baterista se rompió la muñeca. Necesito a alguien para la segunda ronda del viernes. Alguien que me deje un lugar donde estar.

t.en: Run it again. Drop four beats on purpose.
t.zh: 再来一遍，故意空出四拍。
t.ja: Run it again. Drop four beats on purpose.
t.ko: [번역] Run 그것 again. Drop four beats on purpose....
t.es: Tócalo de nuevo. Deja cuatro compases a propósito.

en: I count it off and, at bar five, I just — don't. Four beats of nothing. My whole body itches.
I step into the gap with a low left-hand line I haven't played in years.
He sounded happy. I did that by doing nothing. Disgusting.
zh: 我数拍起奏，到第五小节，我就——不敲了。整整四拍的空白，我浑身发痒。
我走进那个空隙，左手弹出一条好几年没弹过的低音线。
对，就是那儿。我住在那儿。
他听起来很高兴。而我的功劳是什么都没做。太恶心了。
ja: I count it off and, at bar five, I just — don't. Four beats of nothing. My whole body itches.
I step into the gap with a low left-hand line I haven't played in years.
He sounded happy. I did that by doing nothing. Disgusting.
ko: [번역] I count 그것 off 그리고, 에 bar five, I just — don't. Four beats 의 nothing. My whole b...
[번역] I step into 그 gap 함께 한 low left-hand line I haven't played 에서 years....
[번역] He sounded happy. I did 그 에 의해 doing nothing. Disgusting....
es: Lo cuento y, en el compás cinco, simplemente —no. Cuatro compases de nada. Mi cuerpo entero pica.
Entro en el hueco con una línea de mano izquierda baja que no he tocado en años.
Ahí. Ese es el lugar donde vivo.
Sonaba feliz. Lo hice haciendo nada. Asqueroso.

mem.en: Nathan replayed the ending and left four beats empty; Andre filled them and said that's where he lives.
mem.zh: Nathan重奏结尾时空出四拍，Andre接了进来，说那就是他待的地方。

en: “Leave room” isn't a note. Is it fewer fills? Softer ride? Out on the last eight? Give me a number.
I think about it longer than he'd like. Then I write on a napkin: bars 5–8, ride only, no crash.
Fair. I was being vague. It's a bad habit of people who sit down for a living.

你说得对，是我太含糊了。坐着上班的人都有这个坏毛病。

I nod, not offended. I've been the guy who got told to play less. It felt like a firing.
Then come Friday and play how you play. I'll figure out how to live around it.
That was supposed to end it. Why does it feel like he just made room anyway?

那周五就来，照你的方式打。我来想办法绕着你活。
这话本来是要结束谈话的。为什么感觉他还是给我腾了地方？

en: The bartender is cutting limes. Andre counts in a ballad, then plays exactly three notes and takes his hands off the keys.
I wait for the rest. There is no rest. I mean there's only rest. I start laughing and can't stop.
Mostly for when I don't play.
That's the most pianist sentence ever said. I want it on a mug.
I play the three notes again, slower. He's still grinning. It's the first time he's looked at me without checking for a verdict.
We're not locked in. We're barely in the same zip code. And it's the most fun I've had since the tour.

这是史上最钢琴手的一句话。我要把它印在马克杯上。

es: El cantinero está cortando limas. Andre cuenta en una balada, luego toca exactamente tres notas y saca las manos de las teclas.
Espero el resto. No hay resto. Quiero decir que solo hay descanso. Comienzo a reír y no puedo parar.
Esa es la oración de pianista más típica jamás dicha. Quiero que esté en una taza.
Toco las tres notas de nuevo, más lentamente. Sigue sonriendo. Es la primera vez que me mira sin buscar un veredicto.
No estamos bloqueados. Apenas estamos en la misma código postal. Y es lo más divertido que he hecho desde la gira.

I don't argue with his worth. Arguing would make it a debate he could lose.
The chair's yours Friday. If you don't want it, tell me by noon. That's the only thing I need from you.
He didn't take the exit I built him. I don't know what to do with that.

周五的位子是你的。不想要，中午前告诉我。我只需要你这一件事。
他没走我给他修好的那道出口。我不知道该怎么接。

en: The room is full and loud. In the bridge of “Rent Day,” Andre's left hand lands a half step wrong. The chord sours. A table near the front hears it.
Every instinct says: solo, big, cover it with noise. Instead I drop to the rim and play the plainest time I've ever played. A handrail.
I find the rail. I walk back along it. Two bars later I'm home, and nobody at the front table remembers why they looked up.
After the set, in the hallway by the ice machine, Andre is still holding a bar towel he forgot to put down.
You left me a way back.
It wasn't magic. It was eleven hours of practicing not to play.
zh: 场子坐满了，很吵。《交租日》的过门里，Andre的左手按错了半个音，和弦发酸。前排一桌听出来了。
我所有的本能都在喊：独奏，放大，用声音盖过去。我却退到鼓边，打出这辈子最朴素的一段拍子。一条扶手。
我摸到了扶手，顺着它走回来。两小节后我回到了家，前排那桌已经忘了自己刚才为什么抬头。
下台后，在制冰机旁的走廊里，Andre手里还攥着一条忘了放下的吧台毛巾。
你给我留了条回来的路。
这不是魔法。是练了十一个小时的“不弹”。

Cada instinto dice: solo, grande, cúbrelo con ruido. En su lugar bajo al aro y toco el tiempo más simple que jamás he tocado. Un pasamanos.
Encuentro el pasamanos. Camino hacia atrás a lo largo de él. Dos compases después estoy en casa, y nadie en la mesa del frente recuerda por qué levantaron la vista.
